[[The Marketplace]] | pic1 = [[File:Kaineng Docks map.jpg|200px]] | pic1-text = Kaineng Docks | pic2 = [[File:Kaineng to Marketplace map.jpg|200px]] | pic2-text = Path from Kaineng Center to Kaineng Docks | ingame name=Kaineng Docks | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=302 }} [[Kaineng Docks]] is the primary dock area where people travel to and from [[Seitung Harbor]] on [[Shing Jea Island]]. ==Getting there== Talk to [[First Mate Xiang]] in [[Seitung Harbor]] or exit from [[The Marketplace]]. ==Exits== *[[The Marketplace]] (west) *[[Seitung Harbor]] (east) (By talking to [[First Mate Xiang]]) ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: *[[Melandru's Watcher]] **At the docks ==Quests available== :''(quest is only available to [[Factions]] characters)'' *[[Headmaster Greico]] **[[Mayhem in the Market]] {{Quest icon|Primary}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Other allies==== *{{r}} 15 [[Headmaster Greico]] *{{x}} 10 [[First Mate Xiang]] *{{w}} 10 [[Canthan Peasant]]s ==Notes== *Complete exploration of this explorable area contributes approximately 0.2% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title. {{Explorable areas in Kaineng City}} [[de:Docks von Kaineng]]
